Welcome to the RealTime A I Camera.
The home screen has two buttons at the top, Settings and Info and guide, then five tools, then the voice button. Swipe through them, or touch the screen to explore.

Read. Point at printed text and hear it out loud. The Language button at the top picks English, or one of %1$d languages to translate into English. Russian, Ukrainian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Thai and Arabic need their own reader, downloaded once the first time you pick them, then offline. Tap it to step to the next one. The small button next to Speak switches between Auto read, which is on to start and reads new text by itself, Mute, and Tap to read.
Object Detection names the things around you as you move the phone.
What\'s this? takes one careful look. Mail and pages get the point of them, like who sent it and what\'s due. A room gets a description. Afterwards, hold to ask a follow up question.

Help Me Aim takes a good photo for you. Choose Face, Picture or Page, or Something Else and say what you want. It tells you which way to move, counts down, and saves the photo with a description. For things it doesn\'t know by sight, like a wallet, it looks closely and tells you where it is. Double tap anywhere to take the picture yourself.
Live Cam is experimental and coming soon. It lets you talk with the camera. Ask out loud about what\'s in front of you and hear the answer.
In Settings, Models, the app already picked the best A I for your phone. You can choose Most accurate or Fastest there.
Everything runs on your phone and works offline. No accounts and no tracking.
Speak a full guide to the app
Your camera, out loud. Everything runs on your phone.

Point at printed text and hear it read out loud. The Language pill at the top picks English or one of %1$d languages, like Spanish, French, Russian, Chinese or Arabic, and translates it into English. Each language downloads once, then works offline. Russian, Ukrainian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Thai and Arabic also download their reader the first time you pick them; tap the card to get it. Until its pack is on the phone, Spanish still translates with the built-in dictionary. Auto read is on to start: new text is spoken by itself, once. The small button next to Speak switches between Auto read, Mute and Tap to read. Copy keeps the text in your history.
Names the things around you as you move the phone, nonstop, fast and offline.

One careful look. Point at a page, a bill, a package or a room and press the button. Mail and pages get the point of them: who sent it, what it is, what\'s due. A room or a thing gets a description. Afterwards, hold to ask a follow-up question about the same photo.

Takes a good photo for you. Choose Face, Picture or Page, or Something Else and say or type what you want, like keys, a mug or your dog. The app tells you which way to move, counts down and takes the picture, then saves it to your gallery with a description written into it. It knows hundreds of everyday things; for anything else, like a wallet, it looks closely with the describing AI and tells you where it is. Double tap anywhere to take the picture yourself.
Experimental, coming soon. Talk with the camera. Ask out loud about what\'s in front of you and hear the answer, then keep asking.

The Settings button at the top of the home screen. Models: the app picks the best describing AI for your phone by itself and downloads it once, on Wi-Fi. Mail, money and medicine always get the most accurate one your phone can run. In Settings, then Models, you can choose Most accurate or Fastest, or pick one yourself. Settings also has the countdown before photos, the app\'s own voice or TalkBack, and your copy history. The voice button at the bottom of the home screen changes the voice.
Lens toggle, wide or ultra-wide (Object Detection, when the phone has one)
Flashlight, one tap on, one tap off
Everything runs on your phone and works offline, even in Airplane Mode. The bigger AI models and translation languages download once, then stay on your phone.
No accounts, no tracking, no location access. Nothing you point the camera at is uploaded.

What\'s this? runs LFM3-Omni-2B by Liquid AI, on this phone, under the LFM Open License v1.0. Nice Dreamz converted it to GGUF in three sizes (Sharp Q8_0, Clear Q3_K_M, Balanced IQ2_XS); the weights are otherwise unchanged.
Quick: Vision Narrator 0.8B by Nice Dreamz, fine-tuned from Qwen3.5-0.8B by Alibaba Cloud (Apache-2.0)
Read the LFM Open License v1.0
Object Detection: YOLOv8 by Ultralytics (AGPL-3.0), trained on Open Images V7 by Google (CC BY 4.0)
